retrieval_query_or_filters: Metadata-only review of SoilGrids250m version 2.0 global soil-property products. No raster bytes were acquired or committed.
intended_use: Global soil-property and uncertainty context for infiltration/runoff, landslide, drought, wildfire and terrain-conditioned hazard research. SoilGrids is modelled soil information and is not treated as direct field observation or a hazard event catalogue.

licensing.terms_version_or_date: SoilGrids documentation reviewed 2026-08-10; documentation last updated in 2026
licensing.attribution_requirements: Provide CC BY 4.0 attribution and cite the SoilGrids 2.0 scientific reference appropriate to the property used.
licensing.share_alike_or_derivative_requirements: CC BY 4.0 permits adaptation without a share-alike requirement; attribution and indication of changes remain required.
licensing.notes: ISRIC's current SoilGrids documentation states that SoilGrids products have been provided under CC BY 4.0 since 2019. This review covers SoilGrids250m version 2.0 products, not upstream soil-profile observations or third-party covariates as independent datasets.

redistribution.conditions: Source rights for SoilGrids products support redistribution under CC BY 4.0 subject to attribution. OpenCatastrophe approves metadata only; no exact raster layer or tile is admitted.

privacy.notes: The reviewed outputs are public global gridded soil-property predictions and uncertainty layers.

spatial.crs: Product access includes native global gridded services; exact CRS/projection must be preserved from the selected distribution

temporal.extent: SoilGrids250m version 2.0 modelled soil-property release; not an event time series

variables_and_units.name: clay content
variables_and_units.description: Predicted clay content by standard depth interval; exact scaling and statistic must be taken from the selected layer metadata.

variables_and_units.name: sand content
variables_and_units.description: Predicted sand content by standard depth interval.

variables_and_units.name: bulk density
variables_and_units.description: Predicted fine-earth bulk density; source scaling conventions must be preserved by any adapter.

variables_and_units.name: soil organic carbon
variables_and_units.description: Predicted soil organic carbon content by standard depth interval.

variables_and_units.name: prediction interval
variables_and_units.description: Lower/upper uncertainty information corresponding to a 90% prediction interval, expressed in the units of the selected soil property.

review.notes: Metadata-only approval based on current ISRIC documentation and data-sharing policy. Future raw use must select exact property/statistic/depth/grid artifacts, preserve native scale/unit metadata and uncertainty layers, and record byte identities outside Git before asset-specific review.
